model_notes.b0: K=8 multi-phase complex-harmonic recovery + existing ResNet1D, 10 source-only recovery warmup epochs then 50 joint epochs.
model_notes.a0: 4-stage orthonormal Haar/DWA/FAM CNN, shared five-phase RMS scale and fixed 4096->512 block average; no LP4.
model_notes.selection: reuse old source-only score_checkpoints: source clean within 1 percentage point of maximum then maximum mean source val 0,5,10,20,30 dB macro-F1.
model_notes.target_data: 5/0/-5/-10dB derived from same published 10dB measurement residual; negative levels require generated files.
model_notes.limitations: No server train/evaluation or final-holdout performed in this commit.
